en: Black‑and‑white image showing a grand cast‑iron and glass colonnade with ornate Baroque‑style decoration on the right and a domed pavilion with columns in the center background. A wide promenade stretches across the foreground, lined with benches and large trees on the left. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll or sit along the promenade. The scene appears to be from a European spa town. No visible printed text appears on the front.
